name: Bjorn Larsson
bio:
Bjorn Larsson's fascination with motorsport began during his childhood in Gothenburg, witnessing the raw power and engineering marvel of rally cars tearing through the Swedish countryside. He pursued a degree in Aeronautical Engineering at Chalmers University of Technology, focusing on fluid dynamics and aerodynamics. After graduating, Bjorn joined Saab, contributing to aircraft design before making the leap to Formula racing. He spent several years with smaller teams, honing his skills in wind tunnel testing and computational fluid dynamics. 

Bjorn's approach to aerodynamics is meticulous and data-driven. He believes in a collaborative environment where engineers are empowered to challenge conventional wisdom. He is known for his ability to translate complex aerodynamic concepts into practical, race-winning solutions. He joined Oregon Team seeking a fresh challenge and the opportunity to build a competitive aero department from the ground up. His calm demeanor under pressure and mentoring approach make him a valuable asset to the team.

What sets Bjorn apart is his relentless pursuit of aerodynamic efficiency. He is always seeking marginal gains, believing that even the smallest improvements can make a significant difference on the track. He's got a keen eye for detail, and he is not afraid to challenge established methods.

physical.description: Bjorn is a tall, lean man with a serious but kind face.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Swedish coffee in the office, brewed just right.
